title: AYZEN Contract Zero-Gap Exception
description: Phase 06 (Contract Zero-Gap Sprint). One entry per domain-contract-coverage finding (see tools/contract-validator/domain-coverage.mjs) that is accepted as an architectural fact rather than fixed -- e.g. a domain whose public operation genuinely has no HTTP endpoint by design. Consumed by scripts/validate-contract-exceptions.mjs, which fails the build if a current finding has no matching, unexpired entry here, or if an entry here has expired. This is deliberately stricter than scripts/domain-contract-coverage-baseline.json's frozen-forever baseline: every acceptance here has an owner and an expiry, so it comes back for a human decision instead of aging silently.

category.description: Which of computeDomainContractCoverage()'s three finding lists this entry excuses.

key.description: The exact finding string, e.g. 'platform' (ownersWithoutContract/contractsWithoutEndpoints) or 'telegram:resolve-command' (unresolvedOperations, 'domain:operation').

reason.description: Why this is an accepted architectural fact, not a bug -- reviewed by a human, not a placeholder.

owner.description: Team or individual accountable for re-reviewing this exception when it expires.

ticket.description: Optional tracking reference (e.g. a roadmap doc section or issue id) for follow-up work, if any is planned.

expires.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Once today's date passes this, the exception no longer excuses the finding and the gate fails until a human renews (extends the date, having re-confirmed the reason still holds) or resolves it.
